selection.take: first two ranked pages from each nonempty stratum after exclusions
selection.overlap_policy: one page may satisfy more than one stratum

strata.name: outline_or_heading
strata.predicate: page has a body text item with raw label section_header and integer level 1 through 5

strata.name: numbering
strata.predicate: page has a raw section_header whose normalized text matches decimal, article, upper-alpha, or upper-roman grammar

strata.name: appendix_boundary
strata.predicate: page has a raw section_header matching case-insensitive ^Appendix [A-Z] word-boundary

strata.name: numbering_regime_reset
strata.predicate: page contains the first raw section_header matching Article 1 or top-level decimal 1 after a unique exact Appendix outline anchor
strata.reason: The only qualifying page is required development evidence for the page 120 and 180 numbering fixtures, so no independent reset holdout exists in this source.

strata.name: table_or_caption
strata.predicate: page has a Docling table object provenance entry or text item raw label table or caption

strata.name: furniture
strata.predicate: page has a text item with content_layer furniture

strata.name: visible_toc
strata.predicate: page has a body section_header matching normalized ^table of contents(?: \(continued\))?$
strata.reason: Every producer-detected visible-TOC page was already reviewed in Task 03E and is development evidence, so none can be held out honestly.
